name: A Teia
description: A man and a woman with no apparent connection are involved in a bizarre bank robbery, resulting in their death. Their children (Lara and Simão), faced with the impasse in the police investigation, decide to unravel the mystery that led to the tragedy. What they discover is just the tip of the skein. Other deaths follow, all unrelated to view and entangled in a mysterious web that seems to have no end. What will be the next target?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview:
António and Margarida enter the bank. Antonio is impatient, he shoots into the air several times and the panic is generated. Margarida reveals that she has a necklace-bomb and demands that they give her what they want or everything will go through the air.

Augusto delivers the documents of the divorce and reminds her that she will have to support herself.

In Edinburgh, Simon boxing in an illegal fight. Inês sticks to see the fight and accidentally takes an elbow, injuring her head. Ines calls for Simon, who, upon hearing her, takes a violent blow, throwing him to the ground.

Already at home, Inês tries to wake up Simon, rings the doorbell and is a social worker, accompanied by a policeman, who says she is there because she received a report of child abuse. The Social worker is aware of the wound in the head of Inês and Simão can not avoid that take the daughter.

Simon goes to a pub and ventures with Little John that took him to his daughter. Lara, who serves customers, realizes the conversation and offers to help.

Cecilia leaves Margarida at the place she asked him, reads the message and advances to the building. Margarida enters the workshop and Antonio only realizes that it is her after hearing his voice.

Simon is in court and Lara pretends to be his mate, testifying that he is a good father.

Margarida is in a room in a boarding house and has a collar-pump around her neck, calls Antonio and says he needs him. Diana informs James that they received a call with a bomb threat.

Antonio comes from inside the bank with a sack full of notes. The police around the bank and Tiago arrives with Diana. Antonio and Margarida are in a panic and Antonio tells him that it would be best to give himself up, but Margarida denies and clings to a girl.

Margarida and Antonio appear at the bench door. Margarida frees a girl and activates the bomb. Antonio says he will not abandon her, Margarida receives a call and answers, and the bomb explodes.
